description: Find VPS plans, GPU instances or LLM models by words ('openai gpt-5', 'H200', 'official anthropic', 'gemini 3'): every word must be in the SKU id or name; 'official' and lab names are signals. Rows come first-party first (the provider's own price, source_class first_party), then resellers (Amazon Bedrock, Azure ...), then community catalogues (models.dev, LiteLLM, OpenRouter), each row labelled with source_class. gpu and vps rows follow `commitment` (default on-demand: spot and committed prices are left out, as in cheapest_for_spec). Answers with a short `answer` sentence first (human names, price, VAT basis, term, read date, source), then compact rows; verbose=true returns every field of every row. No hit: near matches and did_you_mean. Active SKUs on the provider's public price page or product API by default (listing filter). Read-only; reads the ledger's own daily archive, nothing is fetched live.

commitment.description: gpu and vps rows only. Default on-demand: standing list prices with no term and no interruption. spot, reserved, commit, dynamic or community select those rows; any shows every commitment.
commitment.title: Commitment

listing.description: Listing filter. current (default) = on the provider's public price page or product API; catalog_only = only in an order catalog, not on the public page; vanished = was listed, now missing; unknown = no public page to check against; all = everything. Every row carries listing_status.
listing.title: Listing

provider.description: Provider slug, e.g. vultr, ovhcloud, openai
provider.title: Provider

query.description: Words of the SKU name or id, e.g. 'h100', 'openai gpt-5', 'official anthropic'. Empty matches every active SKU, first-party first.
query.title: Query

verbose.description: true = every field of every row (spec, all price points, extra, cite) and the coverage gaps
verbose.title: Verbose

name: search_skus
title: Search SKUs
